rules.scope: Screened for exported hydrants, crosswalks, access ramps, bus stops, nearby approach controls and reviewed parking signs. Remaining bay bounds are estimates; unrepresented restrictions are not certified.
rules.policy: Withhold permit-only and time-dependent parking until eligibility and a civil clock/duration policy are implemented. Bus-stop clearance is a conservative scenario reserve, not a statutory distance. Mixed-sign rows remain withheld where exact changeover boundaries are not authored.
